numerical_claims.source_value: Operating expenses (including non-recurring) of EUR 68,754 thousand (68.754 million) for H1 2026, representing 11.3% growth vs H1 2025 (EUR 61,791 thousand)
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Expenses table (January-June 2026 row) shows Operating expenses as (68,754) thousand EUR vs (61,791) thousand EUR in 2025. Calculated growth: ((68,754 - 61,791)/61,791)*100 = 11.3%. Text states: 'Higher volumes of equipment sale and increased networks’ interconnection and roaming cost resulted in higher cost of goods and services... Employee related expenses rose mainly due to non-recurring redundancy expenses of EUR 1.4 million...'

numerical_claims.claim: Non-recurring redundancy expenses of 1.4 million euros related to restructuring of the Digital & Technology unit
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Expenses section text: 'Employee related expenses rose mainly due to non-recurring redundancy expenses of EUR 1.4 million related to restructuring of the Company’s Digital & Technology unit during the first half of 2026.'
